summary.text: Trina V. Boyd is the Republican candidate for North Carolina House of Representatives District 104 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Democrat Brandon Lofton.
Boyd was among the candidates in the 2022 Democratic primary for Mecklenburg County Board of Commissioners At-Large, receiving 9.9 percent of the vote and not advancing to the general election.
